senses.gloss: , perf. a. part. זָז (reduplic. of זא or זע, v. זוּעַ, cmp. זָאזָא) to move, go away, depart.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 30a">Yeb. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ומשנה לא זָזָה ממקומה</he> but the Mishnah was not removed from its place, i.e. it was left in the collection as it was, though afterwards repealed or modified.
Gitt. 58ᵃ איני זז מכאן וכ׳ I shall not leave this spot until &c. Tanḥ. Matt. 6; Num. R. s. 22, end, a. e. (play on זוּזִים coins) שזָזִים וכ׳ they leave the one and are given to the other; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:17">Ab. III, 17</cite> <he>אין מְזִיזִין וכ׳</he> they cannot move it (the tree) from its place; <cite ref="Taanit 20a:14">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>מְזִיזוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> <he>אין אתה יכול להָזִיז וכ׳</he> thou canst not remove thy love from them.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:13:1">Koh. R. to I, 13</cite> <he>אינו מֵזִיז ואינו מזיע וכ׳</he> he will not give up studying &c.; a. fr.
